I have worked this land since I was a boy, and my father taught me to put manure from our goats on the mounds. Last season my cousin put one bag of that NPK fertilizer on his yams and his tubers were much bigger than mine, so I will buy one bag for my half-hectare this year. I will cut my own yams and plant the pieces I kept from last season — I have never bought seed from the agro-dealer and I do not trust it. My family will do the planting and weeding, and when it is time for the heavy mounding I will hire two young men from the village for four days each.
